screening_decisions.reason: Randomized, placebo-controlled in adolescents with depression but clomipramine was given intravenously (non-oral), which fails the oral administration criterion.
Randomized, placebo-controlled fluoxetine trial; fluoxetine is an SSRI, not a tricyclic antidepressant.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of the tricyclic nortriptyline in depressed adolescents (12–17 years); route consistent with oral TCA dosing.
Review article, not a randomized controlled trial.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot of imipramine in depressed children; consistent with oral TCA use.
Double-blind crossover randomized trial of amitriptyline vs placebo in children with major depressive disorder; mg/kg/day dosing indicates oral administration.
Systematic review focusing on newer-generation antidepressants (e.g., SSRIs), not a primary RCT of tricyclics in children/adolescents.
Randomized, double-blind imipramine vs placebo (both with CBT) in adolescents with comorbid anxiety and major depressive disorders; includes depression outcomes; oral TCA implied.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled imipramine trial in prepubertal children with major depressive disorder; mg/kg/day dosing indicates oral administration.
Randomized, double-blind trial in adolescents with MDD that includes an imipramine vs placebo comparison (oral titration 200–300 mg).
Narrative review on antidepressant mechanisms; not a randomized controlled trial.
Review of SSRI overdose outcomes; not a randomized controlled efficacy trial of tricyclics in youth.
Methodological paper, not a clinical RCT in children/adolescents.
Observational case series of amitriptyline poisoning; not an RCT of treatment efficacy in depressed youth.

Abstract discusses differential drug vs placebo response rates among depressed children, suggesting underlying randomized, placebo-controlled TCA trial; tricyclic and randomization not explicitly named. Included conservatively.
Randomized, placebo-controlled desipramine trial in adolescents with major depressive disorder; consistent with oral TCA use.
Narrative review on pharmacotherapy of child/adolescent depression; not a randomized controlled trial.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled study in school refusal where depression diagnosis is not clearly established for the sample; population does not clearly meet 'depressed people' criterion.
Poisoning/ingestion outcomes in children; not an efficacy RCT, and population not defined as depressed.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled amitriptyline trial in adolescents with MDD; oral 5 mg/kg/day dosing.
Double-blind clomipramine trial in school refusal/neurotic disorder; does not clearly enroll depressed (MDD) youth.
Meta-analysis of adult (18–65) hospitalized patients; out of the 6–18 years age range.
Imipramine level–response observational study without randomization/placebo control.
Randomized, controlled amitriptyline vs placebo trial in adolescents with treatment-resistant major depressive disorder.
Report focuses on compliance/side effects in an imipramine vs placebo trial for school refusal with anxious-depressed adolescents; efficacy comparison not reported in this paper.
